objective: Delegate only when the benefit exceeds context-transfer and review overhead. Preserve correctness while avoiding unnecessary compute. The model descriptions below are initial routing preferences, not measured guarantees; keep uncertain decisions in the parent.

scout.description: Read-only local repository investigation: find files, trace code paths, explain existing behavior, and return source citations. Cannot use a shell, modify files, or research the web.

models.description: Preferred starting route for bounded file discovery, straightforward code tracing, and factual repository questions.
Preferred route for cross-module analysis, subtle behavior, and investigations needing substantial synthesis.
Reserve for unusually ambiguous architecture or deep reasoning across interacting subsystems.

researcher.description: Read-only research using external documentation and web sources, comparison of alternatives, and evidence-backed recommendations with citations. Cannot implement changes or run a shell.

models.description: Preferred starting route for targeted documentation lookups with a clear factual question.
Preferred route for comparing multiple sources, resolving conflicting documentation, and synthesizing recommendations.
Reserve for difficult technical tradeoffs with substantial ambiguity and deep synthesis.

worker.description: User-authorized implementation of a bounded change with clear acceptance criteria, non-overlapping file ownership, tests, and a report of changes. May modify files and execute tools; not eligible without write authorization. Async only.

models.description: Preferred starting route for mechanical, localized edits with unambiguous instructions and straightforward verification.
Preferred route for ordinary feature implementation, bug fixes, tests, and multi-file changes.
Reserve for difficult concurrency, architecture, or correctness work requiring deep reasoning; not merely because a task involves coding.
